ei.title: 올림포스 전국연합 기출문제집 영어독해 고2 (2026) 3강 Ex05 워크북
ei.subject: 영어

fullPassage: Most people resist the idea of a true self-estimate, probably because they fear that it might mean downgrading some of their beliefs about who they are and what they're capable of. As Goethe's maxim goes, it is a great failing "to see yourself as more than you are." How could you really be considered self-aware if you refuse to consider your weaknesses? Don't fear self-assessment because you're worried that you might have to admit some things about yourself. The second half of Goethe's maxim is important too. He states that it is equally damaging "to value yourself at less than your true worth." We underestimate our capabilities just as much and just as dangerously as we overestimate other abilities. Cultivate the ability to judge yourself accurately and honestly. Look inward to discern what you're capable of and what it will take to unlock that potential.

✅ ③ capabilities: underestimate의 목적어로 명사 복수형 적절

det.analysis:

✅ ③ accurately: '정확하게'로 올바른 판단 문맥에 적절

ch: 괴테의 격언은 자기 과대평가와 과소평가 모두를 경계한다.

questions.passage: Most people resist the idea of a true ①<u>self-estimate</u>, probably because they fear that it might mean downgrading some of their beliefs about who they are and what they're capable of. As Goethe's maxim goes, it is a great failing "to see yourself as more than you are." How could you really be considered self-aware if you refuse to consider your weaknesses? Don't fear self-assessment because you're worried that you might have to ②<u>admit</u> some things about yourself. The second half of Goethe's maxim is important too. He states that ③<u>it is equal damaging</u> "to value yourself at less than your true worth." We underestimate our capabilities just as much and just as dangerously as we overestimate other abilities. Cultivate the ability to judge yourself accurately and honestly. Look inward to discern what you're capable of and what it will take to ④<u>unlock</u> that potential.
questions.stem: 다음 글에서 어법상 틀린 곳을 찾으시오.

det.korean: 괴테 격언의 나머지 절반도 중요하다. 그는 자신의 진정한 가치보다 낮게 평가하는 것이 똑같이 해롭다고 말한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① self-estimate: 복합명사로 적절
✅ ② admit: have to admit에서 동사 원형 적절
❌ ③ equal damaging → equally damaging: 형용사 damaging을 수식하려면 부사 equally가 필요. equal은 형용사이므로 다른 형용사를 수식할 수 없음
✅ ④ unlock: to unlock에서 동사 원형 적절
det.tip: 형용사를 수식하는 것은 부사입니다. equal(형용사) vs equally(부사)를 구별하세요.
